description: This file defines macros, data structures, and function prototypes for the Zephyr testing framework's ztress stress testing macros, focusing on context management for timers and threads within the Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: ztress_execute
methods.description: Runs the stress test with specified timer and thread contexts, managing execution until completion, timeout, or abort.

methods.name: ztress_set_timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for the stress test.

methods.name: ztress_report
methods.description: Prints a report of the last test's execution and preemption counts, timeouts, and CPU load.

methods.name: ztress_exec_count
methods.description: Returns the number of executions of a specific context in the last test.

methods.name: ztress_preempt_count
methods.description: Returns the number of preemptions of a specific context in the last test.

methods.name: ztress_optimized_ticks
methods.description: Provides the optimized timeout value for a specific context based on the last test.
